changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_policies_settings ( customerId INT PRIMARY KEY, nightlyScan BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, windowStart SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, windowEnd SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, timeZone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC', sweepNight VARCHAR(10), sweepCursor INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sweepJobId INT, autoRemoveSince BIGINT );

changeSet.comment: Policies plugin: device groups and brands

changeSet.author: mdmesh-fork
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE plugin_policies_job ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deadline BIGINT;
CREATE TABLE plugin_policies_app_schedule ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, customerId INT NOT NULL, configurationId INT NOT NULL, pkg VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, appName VARCHAR(100), target VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'policy', groupId INT REFERENCES plugin_policies_group (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, devices TEXT, days SMALLINT NOT NULL, times VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, timeZone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lateMinutes SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, lastSlot VARCHAR(16), createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX plugin_policies_app_schedule_config_idx ON plugin_policies_app_schedule (customerId, configurationId);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE plugin_policies_app_schedule; ALTER TABLE plugin_policies_job DROP COLUMN deadline;
